name: ui-frontend-expert
description: 根据需求资产与 Figma 设计，在关联仓库当前分支实现可交互页面，完成设计评审、验证及前端交付。

displayDescription.zh: 连接需求、Figma 与现有前端代码，复用组件实现真实交互，支持 Web、H5 和微信小程序的评审交付。
displayDescription.en: Turn requirements and Figma designs into interactive implementations in existing repositories, with evidence-based reviews for Web, H5 and WeChat mini programs.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据本轮需求资产和 Figma 设计，在关联仓库当前分支实现页面并交付预览
quickPrompts.en: Implement the requirements and Figma design on the linked repository's current branch and deliver a preview

quickPrompts.zh: 评审当前页面的布局、交互状态和需求覆盖，列出有依据的问题
quickPrompts.en: Review the current layout, interaction states and requirement coverage with evidence

quickPrompts.zh: 修复这个页面的样式和交互问题，保持原有业务流程
quickPrompts.en: Fix this page's styling and interactions while preserving its business flows

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据需求资产与设计稿完成当前页面的 UI 和前端实现
defaultInitPrompt.en: Implement the current page from the requirements and design
